runs.name: s0-control
runs.notes: The best configuration on record, mid-16-views-500k, at a thousand steps. Nothing here is comparable to a two-thousand-step run, so this is what the other three are read against.

runs.name: s1-mse
runs.notes: Squared error added to the absolute error at a weight of ten, which puts their gradients on the same scale at the residual a converged run sits at. PSNR is a monotone function of the mean squared error alone, so every run so far has been optimizing the median of the residual and graded on its mean.

runs.name: s2-sup16
runs.notes: The loss taken on sixteen views a step rather than eight. Twice the pixels behind each gradient, at about 1.3 GiB and a fifth of a second more per step, which is affordable now that the view range stops at sixteen.

runs.name: s3-mse-sup16
runs.notes: Both at once, which makes the four runs a two-by-two: with the control and the two singles it gives each change's own effect and whether they add.
